items.quote: We remain fully committed to our medium-term guidance of INR 50,000 Crore AUM by calendar year 2028
items.statement: AUM of INR 50,000 crore by calendar 2028
items.speaker: Ganesh Narayanan

items.quote: accordingly take a call on passing the pricing benefit to the customers in H2 FY27
items.statement: Decision on passing pricing benefit to customers in H2FY27, per pricing policy
items.speaker: Ganesh Narayanan

items.quote: by end of Q2 FY27, probably can look at a 50 bps price cut if we are able to hold the asset quality
items.statement: Possible 50 bps price cut by end Q2FY27, conditional on asset quality
items.speaker: Ganesh Narayanan

items.quote: It may end somewhere at 9.4% average, we may still hold around 9.3%
items.statement: Average borrowing cost around 9.3% in FY27 (start 9.2%, end 9.4%)
items.speaker: Nilesh Dalvi

items.quote: the trailing 12-month credit cost will also drop below 4%
items.statement: Trailing 12-month credit cost to drop below 4%, trending towards 3%
items.speaker: Nilesh Dalvi

items.quote: ensure that our cross-cycle returns are in the range of 4.5% and ROEs are around 18%-20%
items.speaker: Nilesh Dalvi

items.quote: maybe we may have to take 50 bps pricing cut in third quarter, maybe another 50 bps in fourth quarter
items.statement: Possible 50 bps pricing cut in Q3FY27 and another 50 bps in Q4FY27, tied to credit cost
items.speaker: Nilesh Dalvi

tone.label: confident
tone.why: Management says "we remain fully committed to our medium-term guidance" and "Currently, we are much comfortable on the guidance front", while making pricing cuts conditional on credit cost.
